topic: Buying generic OTC medicine vs name-brand (Ronan vs Corinne)

scenes.narration: Name-brand pills and their generic twins usually share the exact same active ingredient. Today's training session begins now!
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, cartoon man named coach vault, athletic build, buzzcut brown hair, red track jacket with gold dollar sign logo, silver whistle, clipboard covered in dollar sign stickers, fingerless training gloves, sweatband, coach vault in a gym holding two identical pill bottles, comic burst banner reads SAME INGREDIENT, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Ronan and Corinne both keep a fully stocked medicine cabinet.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, split panel of man ronan and woman corinne in gym gear beside a stocked cabinet labeled MEDICINE, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Each buys pain relievers, allergy pills, and cold medicine regularly.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, ronan and corinne holding boxes on a gym bench stamped PAIN ALLERGY COLD, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Ronan always grabs the famous name brand on the shelf.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, ronan reaching for a flashy branded box near a gym locker, a banner reads NAME BRAND, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: He trusts the flashy box and pays double the price.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, ronan holding a receipt on a gym mat stamped DOUBLE PRICE, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Corinne compares labels and checks the active ingredient amounts closely.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, corinne holding two boxes in the gym, a magnifier over a label stamped ACTIVE INGREDIENT, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: The store generic matches ingredient for ingredient, milligram for milligram.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, corinne comparing two labels on a gym bench both stamped SAME MILLIGRAMS, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: She buys the generic version and pockets half the cost.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, corinne holding a plain generic box near a gym locker, a tag stamped HALF THE COST, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: One year later Ronan overpaid nearly two hundred dollars total.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, shocked ronan on a gym bench holding pharmacy receipts stamped TWO HUNDRED OVERPAID, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Corinne got the identical relief for half the yearly cost.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, corinne flexing in the gym holding a generic bottle, a tag stamped HALF COST SAME RELIEF, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Same active ingredient, same result, just a cheaper cardboard box.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, corinne holding two boxes side by side in the gym, a banner reads SAME RESULT, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Check the active ingredient and buy the generic. Drop and give me twenty bucks!
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, cartoon man named coach vault, athletic build, buzzcut brown hair, red track jacket with gold dollar sign logo, silver whistle, clipboard covered in dollar sign stickers, fingerless training gloves, sweatband, coach vault blowing a whistle in the gym holding a clipboard reading BUY GENERIC, comic burst banner reads TWENTY BUCKS, kids comic book illustration
